title: Per-entity Repositories (master.py)
scope: Six entity-specific repositories. Five are thin BaseRepository[TModel] subclasses. GradeRepository + DesignGradeMapRepository add finders: GradeRepository.get_by_code(code) → GradeModel | None; DesignGradeMapRepository.get_by_pair(design_id, grade_id) → DesignGradeMapModel | None; DesignGradeMapRepository.list_active_by_design(design_id) → list[DesignGradeMapModel] (joined-loaded grade for AC-019).

success_criteria.manual: All 6 repos importable + GradeRepository.get_by_code + DesignGradeMapRepository.get_by_pair + DesignGradeMapRepository.list_active_by_design all defined.
success_criteria.automated: Covered via service tests (TC-017 uses get_by_code, TC-024 + TC-025 use get_by_pair, TC-019 + TC-031 use list_active_by_design).
success_criteria.definition_of_done: 6 subclasses; 3 extra finders; no raw SQLAlchemy outside this file.
